_comment: Merged config for /seo. Written once by references/foundation.md §1 and never overwritten. null means 'not detected yet, fill on first need'.

site.name: A Place Beyond
site._comment_aliases: Brand name variants an answer engine or a mention search might use, including the misspelling you keep seeing.
site._comment_sitemap_url: The live sitemap (or sitemap index) URL. scripts/health_diff.py --sitemap reads this every run; stack.sitemap_path is the file that generates it.
site._comment_brand_regex: 'A Place Beyond' is a generic phrase (cf. 'The Place Beyond the Pines'). Case-insensitive phrase match keeps the brand split honest; brand_split.py builds the full pattern from this plus site.name and site.aliases.

stack.content_layout: single-page static site; index.html is the only page

figure_style._comment: Auto-detected visual recon (references/visuals.md). Never interview the user about this.
figure_style.notes: Always-dark design; near-black background, muted warm-grey text, 8px radius on links.

gsc._comment: Not verified in any Google account accessible to this host yet. User said they will connect Search Console — see .seo/needs-you.md NY-1.

competitors.name: Inside the Castle
competitors.why: Reference point named by the owner: the press that publishes A Place Beyond. Their site is the model for a small-press book web presence.

competitors.name: Asterism Books
competitors.why: Retailer/distributor that sells the book; its product page is the highest-authority page about the book and the natural inbound link source.

_comment_content_surfaces: Where public pages live in this repo. Single-page static site: only index.html at the root.
_comment_crawl_hubs: Single-page site; the homepage is the only page Google can crawl. GSC not connected, so this is inferred, not derived from last_crawled.

authority._comment: Brand-new single-page site with no rankings. kd_ceiling starts at easy (no GSC page-1 positions to derive from). Re-derive once GSC is connected.

budget._comment: Unattended runs stay under per_run_usd. Cost never overrides a quality gate.

select._comment: Below this rubric score (of a possible 20) the best unblocked candidate loses to measure-only. See references/select.md §7.

logs._comment: No server/CDN logs in the repo (Cloudflare Pages static site). AI-crawler evidence runs on web search + Search Console alone; any report must say so.

radar._comment: Demand radar seeds: topic phrases in the audience's own words (not product names) and the communities where the ideal customer talks.
seeds: music to listen to while reading

git._comment: How a run ends. none: show the diff. pr: commit, push, open a PR with the run record as body, never merge. push_after_commit: user instruction 2026-09-11 — commit and push to main after every SEO improvement (main deploys; user takes deploy authority).

repo._comment: Product-change panel. This repo IS the site: any commit touching these files changed what the public sees.
